dedupe_keys.name: the shear wave velocity profiles database

description: The Shear Wave Velocity Profiles Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Santiago Pujol, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). Shear wave velocity (Vs) profiles are needed for site response analyses and liquefaction susceptibility assessments. This database is a collection of Vs profiles from both NEES and non-NEES projects. Shear wave profiles are often determined via in-situ methods such as cross-hole testing, downhole testing, suspension logging testing, and active and passive surface wave testing. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3jh3d27n. Keywords: databases, geotechnical engineering , shear wave velocity , Vs, surface waves , SASW. Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
